name: [UPDATE] Build and Burn
desc:
🔧 BUILD THE ENGINE. BURN THE STRIP. 🔥 dont forget to like and join our community!!


Bolt together your own engine on the bench, drop it in your car and race it down the quarter mile!

🏁 Beat 50 rivals and 5 bosses on The Strip, then unlock Chapter 2: The Desert - 50 tougher, better-paid rivals and The Sheriff waiting at the end
⚙️ Upgrade everything: pistons, turbos, nitrous, fuel, gearbox, final drive, tyres and chassis
🔩 Tune your own gear ratios and tyre pressure, then test it on the dyno
🎨 Paint your car, pick your tyre smoke and show it off in your garage
🏎️ Race your friends, put a wager on it, or go for the half mile
🧰 Hit the tool machines and claim your daily reward

🚨 NEW UPDATE COMING SOON 🚨
A brand-new showroom with car tiers from D to S, and a huge wave of new cars - hot hatches, drift coupes, JDM legends, muscle and full-on supercars. Every car with its own look, interior and wheels.

Which one will be yours? 👀

llm.loop: assemble an engine on the bench -> put it in your car -> drag race rivals and bosses on the strip -> earn cash -> upgrade and tune parts -> unlock the next chapter
llm.objectives: beat 50 rivals and bosses on each strip
llm.instructions: build the engine, tune it on the dyno, race the quarter mile
unique: bench engine assembly with real tuning (gear ratios, tyre pressure)
llm.thumbnails: engine bench with '100+ upgrades', 'Dragsters are now here', Halloween ambulance
llm.complexity_notes: engine assembly and tuning model, drag strip with AI rivals
